description: All-in-one collaborative doc platform that combines docs, spreadsheets, and apps.
auth_notes: Uses API tokens (bearer tokens) generated from account settings or OAuth2 for public integrations.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Coda account and generate personal API tokens self-serve under account settings.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering docs, pages, tables, rows, columns, formulas, controls, and automations.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Coda; community-created MCP servers may exist.
rationale: Coda provides a broad, fully documented REST API with self-serve free credential generation via user account settings.

evidence.note: Coda developer portal describing API access and authentication tokens.
Coda account settings page where users generate API tokens for free.
Coda API v1 documentation covering comprehensive REST endpoints.
